domains.name: Newborn Care Interventions
domains.summary: Indicators of medical interventions for newborns such as antibiotics, ventilation support, NICU admission, seizures, and surfactant use.

domains.name: Apgar Scores
domains.summary: Ten-minute and five-minute Apgar scores and their recoded versions for assessing newborn health at birth.

domains.name: Birth Details
domains.summary: Attendant at birth, place of birth, facility type, breastfeeding status, BMI, body mass index, birth weight recodes, congenital anomalies, and smoking history during pregnancy.

domains.name: Smoking History
domains.summary: Recode variables for cigarette use before and during each trimester of pregnancy.

domains.name: Pregnancy Duration
domains.summary: Combined gestational age in weeks, imputation flag, detailed birth weight, last menstrual period month and year.

domains.name: Birth Details 2
domains.summary: Detailed birth weight in grams, delivery method recode, birth date components (month, day of week, time, year), plurality recode, delivery weight recode.

domains.name: Demographics and Marital Status
domains.summary: Marital status, father's combined age, race/ethnicity recodes, education level, Hispanic origin, reporting flags for various demographic variables.

domains.name: Reporting Flags
domains.summary: Flags indicating whether data on medical interventions and conditions were reported or imputed.
